_about: Story steps per location, in play order. Gift and trainer links point at the game data on the same page. Places in _checked were checked against the pokefirered event scripts; the rest are Draft.
pallet-town: Go downstairs and try to walk into the tall grass north of town. Professor Oak stops you and takes you to his lab.

Pick your {gift:mon-professor-oaks-lab-starter-pok-mon-bulbasaur-charmander-or-squirtle}. Bulbasaur makes the first two Gyms easiest; Charmander makes them hardest. Your rival takes the one strong against yours.
Battle {trainer:rival-oaks-lab} in the lab before you leave. Win or lose, the story carries on. Then head north on {loc:route-1}.
Come back with Oak's Parcel from the {loc:viridian-city} Poké Mart. Oak gives you the {gift:item-professor-oaks-lab-pok-dex} and {gift:item-professor-oaks-lab-pok-ball-5}.
Visit your rival's house: Daisy gives you the {gift:item-rivals-house-town-map}. Your bedroom PC holds a {gift:item-players-house-2f-potion-in-your-pc}.
route-1: A Poké Mart employee hands out a free {gift:item-outside-potion}.
You can't catch anything until Oak gives you Poké Balls, so for now walk north to {loc:viridian-city}. On the way back you can catch {mon:16} and {mon:19}.
viridian-city: The Poké Mart clerk gives you {gift:item-mart-oak-s-parcel}. Take it back to Professor Oak in {loc:pallet-town}.
After the delivery, the grumpy old man who was blocking the road north shows you how to catch Pokémon and gives you the {gift:item-outside-teachy-tv}.
The Gym is locked for now. Head west to {loc:route-22} for an optional rival battle, then north to {loc:route-2}.

Later: the Gym opens once you have seven badges. Beat {trainer:leader-giovanni} (Ground): Water, Grass and Ice moves win, and Flying types dodge Earthquake. Reward: Earth Badge and {gift:item-gym-tm26}.
route-22: Once you have the Pokédex, your rival waits here for an optional battle ({trainer:rival-route22-early}). If you go to Cerulean first, the chance is gone.
Catch {mon:56} here: its Fighting moves help against Brock.
The Pokémon League gate at the west end needs all eight badges. After you beat Giovanni, your rival is waiting here again for a tougher battle ({trainer:rival-route22-late}).
route-2: Head north into {loc:viridian-forest}. The east side of the route is behind small trees, so come back with Cut (or through {loc:digletts-cave}).

With Cut: Professor Oak's aide in the east building gives you {gift:item-east-building-hm05} once you have caught 10 kinds of Pokémon. The house has a trade: {gift:trade-house-trade-give-abra-get-mr-mime-mimien}.
viridian-forest: A maze of Bug Catchers. {mon:25} is rare here, so catch one now if you want it early. Exit north to {loc:pewter-city}.
pewter-city: Beat {trainer:leader-brock} (Rock). Water and Grass moves win; Charmander learns Metal Claw at Lv 13, or bring a {mon:56} from Route 22. Reward: Boulder Badge and {gift:item-gym-tm39}.
As you head east toward Route 3, Professor Oak's aide catches up with you and gives you the {gift:item-outside-running-shoes}.
Later, with Cut: the scientist in the Museum's back room gives you the {gift:item-museum-1f-old-amber}.
route-3: A long run of trainers. Catch {mon:39}, {mon:21}, {mon:56} and Nidoran here. The Pokémon Center at the end, by Mt. Moon, is on {loc:route-4}.
mt-moon: Zubat, Geodude, Paras and the rare {mon:35} live here. There is a Moon Stone on 1F and a hidden one on B2F.
On B2F, beat Team Rocket and then {trainer:super-nerd-miguel}. Pick the {gift:item-b2f-dome-fossil} (Kabuto) or the {gift:item-b2f-helix-fossil} (Omanyte); the other is gone for good.
Exit to the east half of {loc:route-4} and continue to {loc:cerulean-city}.
route-4: The Pokémon Center by Mt. Moon has a salesman who sells a {gift:mon-pok-mon-center-1f-magikarp-lv-5} for ₽500. It evolves into Gyarados at Lv 20.
After Mt. Moon, the east half of the route leads down a ledge to {loc:cerulean-city}.
cerulean-city: Your rival stops you on the bridge north of town. Beat {trainer:rival-cerulean} and he gives you the {gift:item-outside-fame-checker}.
Beat {trainer:leader-misty} (Water). Grass and Electric moves win; her Starmie is fast and hits hard. Reward: Cascade Badge and {gift:item-gym-tm03}.
A Team Rocket Grunt robbed the house by the Gym. Beat him behind the house to get {gift:item-outside-tm28}.
The Bike Shop trades a {gift:item-bike-shop-bicycle} for the Bike Voucher from Vermilion. A house has a trade: {gift:trade-house-3-trade-give-poliwhirl-get-jynx-zynx}.
route-24: Nugget Bridge: beat five trainers in a row, then a Team Rocket recruiter, who gives you a {gift:item-outside-nugget}.
{mon:63} lives in the grass here. It only knows Teleport, so throw a ball on the first turn.
route-25: Visit Bill in the Sea Cottage at the end. Help him with the Cell Separator, and he gives you the {gift:item-sea-cottage-s-s-ticket}.
Then go back through {loc:cerulean-city} and south to {loc:route-5}.
route-5: The Day Care here raises one Pokémon for you (it does not breed). Take the Underground Path south to reach {loc:route-6} and {loc:vermilion-city}.
underground-path-north-south: In the north entrance, a man trades Nidoran: {gift:trade-north-entrance-trade-give-nidoran-get-nidoran-ms-nido}.
vermilion-city: Board the S.S. Anne with the S.S. Ticket.

The Fishing Guru gives you the {gift:item-house-1-old-rod}. The Fan Club Chairman gives you the {gift:item-pok-mon-fan-club-bike-voucher} if you listen to his story. Another house has a trade: {gift:trade-house-2-trade-give-spearow-get-farfetch-d-ch-ding}.
A small tree blocks the Gym, so you need Cut from the S.S. Anne. Inside, find the two switches in the trash cans.
Beat {trainer:leader-lt-surge} (Electric). Ground types are immune: {mon:50} from {loc:digletts-cave} is perfect. Reward: Thunder Badge and {gift:item-gym-tm34}.
ss-anne: Explore the cabins for items. Beat {trainer:rival-ss-anne} near the Captain's room, then rub the Captain's back to get {gift:item-captains-office-hm01}. The ship leaves once you get off.
route-11: Professor Oak's aide upstairs in the gate gives you the {gift:item-east-entrance-2f-itemfinder} once you have caught 30 kinds of Pokémon. The gate also has a Nidorino/Nidorina trade.
digletts-cave: Catch {mon:50} and {mon:51}: Ground types make Lt. Surge easy. The far end comes out on {loc:route-2}, so you can reach its east side.
route-9: Cut the tree east of Cerulean. Lots of trainers on the way to {loc:rock-tunnel}.
route-10: The Pokémon Center by Rock Tunnel has another of Oak's aides: he gives you the {gift:item-pok-mon-center-1f-everstone} once you have caught 20 kinds of Pokémon.
The {loc:power-plant} is down the river, once you can Surf.
rock-tunnel: Pitch dark without Flash (HM05 from the aide on {loc:route-2}). Exit south to {loc:lavender-town}.
lavender-town: {loc:pokemon-tower} is full of ghosts you can't identify yet. You need the Silph Scope from Celadon's {loc:rocket-hideout}.
After you rescue Mr. Fuji at the top of the tower, he gives you the {gift:item-volunteer-pok-mon-house-pok-flute}, which wakes the sleeping Snorlax.
route-8: The guard at the Saffron gate is thirsty and won't let you in. Get Tea from the old woman in {loc:celadon-city}, then give it to him.
Until then, take the Underground Path west to {loc:route-7} and Celadon.
underground-path-east-west: Connects Route 8 and Route 7, skipping Saffron.
celadon-city: The old woman on the first floor of the Condominiums gives you {gift:item-condominiums-1f-tea}, which gets you past the Saffron guards. Take the back stairs to the roof room for a free {gift:mon-condominiums-roof-room-eevee-lv-25}.
The Department Store sells evolution stones and TMs. On the roof, the thirsty girl gives you a TM for each drink from the vending machines: Fresh Water, Soda Pop or Lemonade.
Beat {trainer:leader-erika} (Grass). You need Cut to reach the Gym. Fire, Flying, Ice and Poison moves win. Reward: Rainbow Badge and {gift:item-gym-tm19}.
The man in the restaurant gives you the {gift:item-restaurant-coin-case}. The poster in the Game Corner hides the switch to the {loc:rocket-hideout}.
rocket-hideout: A spin-tile maze. A Grunt on B4F drops the {gift:item-b4f-lift-key} for the elevator.
Beat {trainer:boss-giovanni} on B4F. He leaves the {gift:item-b4f-silph-scope}; take it to {loc:pokemon-tower}.
pokemon-tower: Your rival is on 2F ({trainer:rival-pokemon-tower}). From 3F up, you need the Silph Scope to see the ghosts.
The Marowak ghost on 6F can't be caught. Beat the Rocket Grunts on 7F to rescue Mr. Fuji, then visit him in {loc:lavender-town}.
route-12: Snorlax blocks the route. Save first, then wake it with the Poké Flute: this is your only chance to catch it.
The Fishing Guru's brother gives you the {gift:item-fishing-house-super-rod}. Upstairs in the north gate, a girl gives you {gift:item-north-entrance-2f-tm27}.
route-13: A maze of fences with a grid of trainers. {mon:132} hides in the grass.
route-15: Professor Oak's aide upstairs in the west gate gives you the {gift:item-west-entrance-2f-exp-share} once you have caught 50 kinds of Pokémon.
route-16: Cycling Road starts here; you need the Bicycle. A second Snorlax sleeps by the gate (save first).

The woman in the house behind a Cut tree gives you {gift:item-house-hm02}. Professor Oak's aide in the north gate gives you the {gift:item-north-entrance-2f-amulet-coin} once you have caught 40 kinds of Pokémon.
route-18: A man in the east gate trades for {mon:108}: he wants a Golduck in FireRed or a Slowbro in LeafGreen.
fuchsia-city: Beat {trainer:leader-koga} (Poison). The Gym has invisible walls. Psychic and Ground moves win. Reward: Soul Badge and {gift:item-gym-tm06}.
The Fishing Guru gives you the {gift:item-house-2-good-rod}. Bring the Warden his Gold Teeth from the Safari Zone for {gift:item-wardens-house-hm04}.
safari-zone: Catch {mon:113}, {mon:115}, {mon:128}, and Scyther (FireRed) or Pinsir (LeafGreen). Fish for {mon:147}.
Reach the Secret House at the back for {gift:item-secret-house-hm03}, and pick up the Gold Teeth on the way.
saffron-city: Give the gate guard some Tea to get in. Team Rocket has taken over: a Grunt blocks the Gym door until you clear {loc:silph-co}.
The Dojo is open: beat the Karate Master and pick {gift:mon-dojo-hitmonlee-lv-25-choose-one} or {gift:mon-dojo-hitmonchan-lv-25-choose-one}.
Beat {trainer:leader-sabrina} (Psychic). Bug and Ghost moves are strong, or hit hard with physical moves. The Gym is a maze of warp pads. Reward: Marsh Badge and {gift:item-gym-tm04}.
silph-co: Find the Card Key on 5F to open the locked doors. A Silph employee on 7F gives you {gift:mon-7f-lapras-lv-25}.
Beat {trainer:rival-silph} on 7F and {trainer:boss-giovanni-2} on 11F. The President then gives you the {gift:item-11f-master-ball}.
power-plant: Surf down the river from {loc:route-10}. Zapdos waits at the back (Lv 50; save first). Some item balls are really Voltorb or Electrode.
route-20: Surf west. The {loc:seafoam-islands} sit in the middle of the route.
seafoam-islands: Push boulders with Strength to slow the current, then reach Articuno on B4F (Lv 50; save first).
cinnabar-island: The Gym is locked: get the Secret Key from the {loc:pokemon-mansion}.
The Pokémon Lab revives fossils: the Dome Fossil, Helix Fossil and Old Amber become Kabuto, Omanyte and Aerodactyl. The lab also has three trades.
Beat {trainer:leader-blaine} (Fire). Water, Ground and Rock moves win. Reward: Volcano Badge and {gift:item-gym-tm38}.
Bill is waiting at the Pokémon Center after you win, and takes you to {loc:one-island}.
pokemon-mansion: Statue switches open and close doors. The Secret Key is on B1F.
one-island: Bill introduces you to Celio. Bill gives you the {gift:item-pok-mon-center-1f-meteorite} to deliver to the Game Corner owner on {loc:two-island}, and Celio gives you the {gift:item-pok-mon-center-1f-tri-pass}.

After the National Pokédex, Celio asks for the Ruby from {loc:mt-ember}. Bring it back for the {gift:item-pok-mon-center-1f-rainbow-pass}, which opens Four to Seven Island. Then he asks for the Sapphire.
Bring Celio the Sapphire to link up with Hoenn. That also opens {loc:cerulean-cave} and sets a legendary beast roaming Kanto.
kindle-road: A long route north to {loc:mt-ember}. Rock Smash rocks, fishing spots, and the {loc:ember-spa}.
ember-spa: A man in the spa gives you {gift:item-kindle-road-ember-spa-hm06}.
treasure-beach: Hidden items all along the sand.
mt-ember: Two Team Rocket Grunts at the foot of the mountain let slip the first warehouse password, "Goldeen need log." Beat them to get past.
Moltres is at the summit (Lv 50; needs Strength and Rock Smash; save first). The Ruby is at the bottom of Ruby Path, after the National Pokédex.
two-island: Deliver the Meteorite. The Game Corner owner's granddaughter Lostelle has gone missing, and he asks you to search {loc:three-island}.
After you rescue Lostelle, he gives you a {gift:item-joyful-game-corner-moon-stone}. Move tutors appear here later.
cape-brink: A move tutor teaches your fully evolved starter its ultimate move (Frenzy Plant, Blast Burn or Hydro Cannon) if it is very friendly.
three-island: Bikers have taken over the town. Beat them and their leader {trainer:cue-ball-paxton}.
The townsperson who stood up to them gives you a {gift:item-outside-full-restore}. Get it before you rescue Lostelle, because the defenders leave after that.
berry-forest: Find Lostelle. A wild Hypno attacks (Lv 30; save first). She gives you an {gift:item-berry-forest-iapapa-berry}.
Then head back to {loc:one-island} and to Kanto for the last badge in {loc:viridian-city}.
three-isle-port: A small harbor area south of {loc:three-island}. {mon:206} lives here.
route-21: Surf between {loc:pallet-town} and {loc:cinnabar-island}. {mon:114} lives in the grass.
route-23: Guards check each badge on the way to {loc:victory-road}.
victory-road: Strength boulder puzzles. Watch out for strong {mon:67} and {mon:95}.
indigo-plateau: The last Pokémon Center and Mart before the Elite Four. Stock up on Full Restores and Revives.
pokemon-league: Beat {trainer:elite-four-lorelei} (Ice), {trainer:elite-four-bruno} (Fighting), {trainer:elite-four-agatha} (Ghost) and {trainer:elite-four-lance} (Dragon) in a row, then {trainer:champion-first} for the title.
After the credits, visit Professor Oak with at least 60 kinds of Pokémon caught: he upgrades you to the National Pokédex. That opens the rest of the Sevii Islands.
cerulean-cave: The guard steps aside once you bring Celio the Sapphire. Mewtwo waits at the bottom (Lv 70). Bring your best Poké Balls, or the Master Ball.
three-isle-path: A tunnel with a Dunsparce colony. The prospector gives you a {gift:item-dunsparce-tunnel-nugget} after he strikes gold.
four-island: Lorelei's hometown. The Day Care here can breed Pokémon. {loc:icefall-cave} is to the north.
icefall-cave: Ice-floor puzzles. At the back, Lorelei asks you to help her drive off Team Rocket poachers who are taking Lapras.
five-isle-meadow: The Rocket Warehouse door needs two passwords: one from the Grunts at {loc:mt-ember}, one from Gideon in {loc:dotted-hole}.
memorial-pillar: Bring Lemonade to the man at the pillar for {gift:item-memorial-pillar-tm42}.
water-labyrinth: The old man gives you a {gift:mon-water-labyrinth-togepi-egg} if your lead Pokémon has max friendship and you have an empty party slot.
resort-gorgeous: Selphy asks to see a specific Pokémon (repeatable).
rocket-warehouse: Enter with both passwords. Beat the Team Rocket Admins and {trainer:scientist-gideon}, who hands over the {gift:item-rocket-warehouse-sapphire}.
lost-cave: A foggy maze. Selphy from {loc:resort-gorgeous} is lost deep inside.
water-path: A boy in a house wants to see a {mon:214}: show him one for a {gift:item-water-path-house-1-nest-ball}.
ruin-valley: Use Cut and Strength to open the {loc:dotted-hole} (a Braille puzzle).
dotted-hole: The Sapphire is at the bottom, but Gideon grabs it. He tells you the second warehouse password, "Yes, nah, Chansey," and runs off to sell it to Team Rocket.
altering-cave: Only {mon:41} lives here in normal play.
seven-island: The {loc:trainer-tower} is to the north, and {loc:sevault-canyon} to the south.
sevault-canyon: Tough trainers. {mon:231}, {mon:246} and, in FireRed, Skarmory live here.
tanoby-key: A Strength puzzle that unlocks the Tanoby Chambers (needs the National Pokédex and the Rainbow Pass story finished).
tanoby-ruins: {mon:201} forms are spread across the seven chambers.
roaming: Once you bring Celio the Sapphire, one legendary beast roams Kanto: Entei if you picked Bulbasaur, Suicune if you picked Charmander, Raikou if you picked Squirtle. It flees on the first turn, so trap it or put it to sleep.
navel-rock: Event only: needs the Mystic Ticket. Lugia and Ho-Oh (Lv 70).
birth-island: Event only: needs the Aurora Ticket. Deoxys (Lv 30) after the triangle puzzle.
